items.text: For Siemens Healthineers (SHL), using available data items, NOPAT for FY2020-FY2026 can be approximated as EBIT plus amortization from IFRS 3 purchase price allocation (only available for FY2025) less taxes at the year's effective tax rate less income attributable to non-controlling interests after tax (using the same effective tax rate). For FY2020, EBIT of €1,982 million less tax at the effective rate of 27.2% (derived from income tax of €532 million over pre-tax income of €1,954 million) less non-controlling interests of €12 million taxed at the same rate gives NOPAT of €1,433.6 million. For FY2021, EBIT of €2,573 million, effective tax rate of 27.4% (tax of €658 million over pre-tax income of €2,404 million), and non-controlling interests of €18 million, give NOPAT of €1,855.7 million. For FY2022, EBIT of €2,927 million, effective tax rate of 26.6% (tax of €746 million over pre-tax income of €2,800 million), non-controlling interests of €17 million, give NOPAT of €2,134.7 million. For FY2023, EBIT of €2,135 million, effective tax rate of 20.9% (tax of €403 million over pre-tax income of €1,928 million), non-controlling interests of €16 million, give NOPAT of €1,676.1 million. For FY2024, EBIT of €2,807 million, effective tax rate of 22.4% (tax of €564 million over pre-tax income of €2,523 million), non-controlling interests of €17 million, give NOPAT of €2,166.3 million. For FY2025, EBIT of €3,154 million plus amortization from purchase price allocation of €357 million, effective tax rate of 24.0% (tax of €686 million over pre-tax income of €2,853 million), non-controlling interests of €23 million, give NOPAT of €2,649.3 million. For FY2026, EBIT of €3,196 million, effective tax rate of 22.4% (tax of €646 million over pre-tax income of €2,890 million), non-controlling interests of €29 million, give NOPAT of €2,459.1 million. Amortization from purchase price allocation and non-interest-bearing current liabilities beyond trade payables are not available for FY2020-FY2022, FY2024 and FY2026, so NOPAT for those years omits the add-back used for FY2025.
